defects_fixed.before: Operations were listed outside the OpenAI parameter contract, leaving persona-language routing underspecified.
defects_fixed.after: Each operation now has a deterministic enum and persona-oriented description in the tool parameter schema.

defects_fixed.before: Output language could imply execution, assignment, dispatch, movement, supplier action, or outbound communication.
defects_fixed.after: The agent recommends review options only and never contacts, qualifies, selects, or orders from suppliers. Every output labels the fixed data and exact figures as synthetic.

defects_fixed.before: The agent mixed non-semiconductor suppliers into every view, labeled tiers CRITICAL/HIGH/MODERATE, used real company names for backups, and had no mitigation plan, financial case, roadmap, or monitoring design; the review-scope spend counted the wrong suppliers.
defects_fixed.after: The default view is the Taiwan/China/Malaysia semiconductor scope with 40/35/25% supply shares and five risk categories; HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW levels; fictional backup names; new mitigation_plan, financial_impact ($1.098M, 65% exposure reduction, 8.8% break-even), implementation_roadmap, and monitoring_plan operations as recommendations only; review-scope spend is computed from the listed suppliers.

claim_policy: Public catalog and architecture copy is qualitative. Exact figures and identifiers appear only in clearly labeled synthetic evidence.
